# awscc_route53_record_set_protection (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Route53::RecordSetProtection. Protects a record set (all record sets with the given name and type) in a hosted zone against changes until the protection is deleted. The protection must DependsOn (or reference with Ref) the AWS::Route53::RecordSet it protects. Adding or removing a protection and changing that record set must be two separate stack updates: a removal is applied in the cleanup phase after updates, and an addition in the same update blocks the record set's rollback. To recover a rollback blocked this way (UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED), delete the protection, then run ContinueUpdateRollback. While a protection exists, creating any record set with its name and type, including one with a new SetIdentifier, is refused. Changing Comment replaces the protection by deleting it first, so the record set is unprotected for the duration of the replacement. While a protection exists, including one kept by DeletionPolicy Retain or created outside the stack, deleting its AWS::Route53::RecordSet fails with ResourceConflict; delete the protection first. When a create is retried after its outcome was lost, an existing protection with the same Comment is taken as the one it created; without a Comment, an existing protection that has no comment is adopted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosted_zone_id` (String) The ID of the hosted zone that contains the record set to protect.
- `record_name` (String) The name of the record set to protect.
- `record_type` (String) The DNS record type of the record set to protect.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment that describes the protection.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_route53_record_set_protection.example
  identity = {
    hosted_zone_id = "hosted_zone_id"
    record_name    = "record_name"
    record_type    = "record_type"
  }
}
```
